title:
Microsoft is giving away 100% FREE exam vouchers for DP-600, DP-700, and DP-800 — three of the most in-demand certifications in data right now. 🔥
This is part of Microsoft Fabric Data Days 2026, running now through August 10.

Here's how to qualify:
1. Join the Microsoft Fabric Community
2. Watch 2 Data Days sessions (live or on-demand)
3. Complete 3 required Microsoft Learn modules
4. Submit your request form before the deadline

DP-600 → Fabric Analytics Engineer
DP-700 → Fabric Data Engineer
DP-800 → SQL AI Database Developer

Vouchers are limited, so don't wait until the last week.

🔗 Full registration link: https://community.fabric.microsoft.com/t5/custom/page/page-id/campaign_form?campaignID=Y2FtcGFpZ24tMTc4MTEwNTMxMDAxMQ%3D%3D

Save this so you don't lose it or share with someone who needs to get certified for free!
